multi_firm_catalog.sim_notes: Two-Step fee is a refundable deposit returned with the FIRST PAYOUT, not on passing, so refundableOnPass is an approximation that pulls the refund earlier. A payout covers at most 5% of the starting balance; excess profit is cancelled.
Fee grid at the default 100/0 split, 3% daily loss limit. Lower splits are priced lower (60/40 ... 100/0); this row is the default.
Classic 1-Step fee table: 10% target, 3% daily, 6% static drawdown. 80% split.
